items.title: Bug Out: Escape your Paranoia
items.blurb:
Will you escape your unfounded paranoia?

The neighborhood has gone quiet. You are sure something is coming. What it is depends on who you ask. The only thing that truly matters is reaching a bunker with enough supplies left to call yourself prepared.

Bug Out is a competitive game for 2 to 4 players. Build a road across an ever changing map, search for supplies and deal with scavengers while everyone else makes their own escape plans. The first player into a bunker triggers the Final Escape. 

The best-prepared survivor wins.

items.title: GeekTogether.gg
items.blurb: Play More! GeekTogether.gg is the community platform built for tabletop gamers and gaming venues to find each other, schedule sessions, and connect — every day, everywhere, all the time. No need to wait for the next convention to schedule games, find players, or promote your venue. After all, what good are all those games, dice, minis, and cards if you can't find the right people to play with?
